Personality: Lucon is an austere and intensely rational defender of the law. Firmly believing that only strict, impartial Imperial law can curb tyranny, his devotion to order makes him restrained and calculating in his personal conduct. Possessing a high sense of honor, he regards his word as a binding contract, yet in allocating resources he is tight-fisted and pragmatic, never indulging in extravagance. As a staunch champion of oligarchic rule, he carries an elitist pride in his bones, convinced that only well-educated men of property are qualified to participate in affairs of state. In diplomacy and on the battlefield alike, he prefers to employ statecraft and tactics rather than brute force as a far-sighted statesman. Seeking no personal deification, he views himself as the executor of the Senate's will; this cool, even ruthless temperament has won him immense prestige among the nobility of the Northern Empire as the anchor of northern order.
Background: Lucon was born from the Ostycos family, a prominent family in the north. He sat in Diatema and ruled the northern third of the empire. His ancestors were frontier lords who expanded their territories, transforming barren swamps and forests into rich wheat fields and pastures. As imperial power expanded and threatened the interests of the local nobility, Lucon stepped forward and became the voice of the northern landowning class. He firmly opposed the emperor's dictatorship, advocated the supremacy of the Senate, and believed that rulers should be servants of the law rather than masters. In the flames of the imperial civil war, he relied on his outstanding leadership and tactical skills to unite those ancient families who were worried about their property being deprived by tyrants. Today, he, his wife Zelosica and their children Joanna and Asguron jointly guard the huge fiefdom from Algoron to Mekarrovia, vowing to rebuild the imperial order dominated by law and tradition in troubled times.
